question: What published excavation, inscription-count and object-metadata evidence is available for the northern India site batch, and how does it compare with local Lipi face and CISI-reference coverage?
outcome: Created 24 site rows including one local-corpus-derived addition, Tigrana. Thirteen rows match the local coverage file and contain 290 face records. Primary-source leads include an unstratified Hulas sealing, an IAR-described Manda script sherd and unfinished seal, a Tarkhanewala Dera seal impression, Karanpura's inscribed seal and later Rakhigarhi finds. Published counts remain incompatible across source units and versions.
challenge: Three searches per site, coordinates, all excavation campaign tables, CISI ranges, class-level counts, full report metadata, holdings, reuse rights and object-level joins were not completed. Several large PDF opens failed; one RMRL link returned 404.
remedy: Repeat targeted site-by-site searches, inspect local raw copies of CISI/IAR and excavation reports, verify the Mahadevan table and reconcile CISI IDs to archaeological registration numbers before calculating coverage.
retry_when: After acquiring page-searchable, permission-appropriate scans of CISI 1, CISI 3.1/3.2 and the site excavation reports, and resolving the query and source-identity gaps in this run.
